exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The window should be repaired.
exercises.german: Das Fenster sollte repariert werden.
exercises.why: sollte as the Konjunktiv II of sollen, then Partizip II, and werden closes the passive form.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The application must be submitted by Friday.
exercises.german: Der Antrag müsste bis Freitag eingereicht werden.
exercises.why: müsste deductive in the first slot, einreichen as Partizip II, werden last: no würde anywhere.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The documents ought not to be copied.
exercises.german: Die Unterlagen dürften nicht kopiert werden.
exercises.why: dürften is the plural Konjunktiv II form, and the negation sits between modal and Partizip II.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The problem should be discussed at the meeting.
exercises.german: Das Problem sollte auf der Sitzung besprochen werden.
exercises.why: besprechen with a prepositional phrase still gives the plain modal passive order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The text must be translated by tomorrow.
exercises.german: Der Text müsste bis morgen übersetzt werden.
exercises.why: The time phrase does not disturb the modal, Partizip II, werden sequence.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The street should be closed earlier than that.
exercises.german: Die Straße sollte früher gesperrt werden.
exercises.why: A comparison with als stays outside the passive verb group, which keeps werden final.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The meeting could be postponed.
exercises.german: Die Sitzung könnte verschoben werden.
exercises.why: könnte in Konjunktiv II marks possibility here; the modal is the only conjugated verb.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The house should be sold soon.
exercises.german: Das Haus sollte bald verkauft werden.
exercises.why: The adverb bald sits between subject and verb group and does not reorder werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: A new rule should be introduced.
exercises.german: Eine neue Regel sollte eingeführt werden.
exercises.why: The subject is itself newly introduced, but it does not affect the passive word order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The parcel should be signed for on delivery.
exercises.german: Die Sendung müsste bei der Annahme quittiert werden.
exercises.why: quittieren gives quittiert in the middle slot; only werden closes the predicate.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The data should be deleted after the deadline.
exercises.german: Die Daten müssten nach der Frist gelöscht werden.
exercises.why: Plural subject takes the müssten ending, and the temporal phrase stays before the verb group.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The old bridge should be demolished.
exercises.german: Die alte Brücke sollte abgerissen werden.
exercises.why: A separable prefix verb in the passive keeps the prefix glued to the Partizip II.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The proposal should not be rejected so quickly.
exercises.german: Der Vorschlag sollte nicht so schnell abgelehnt werden.
exercises.why: The negation and the intensifier go inside the passive group, but werden stays in final position.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: A new staircase could be built here.
exercises.german: Hier könnte eine neue Treppe gebaut werden.
exercises.why: Fronting the adverb before the subject is possible because modal and participle form a bracket.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The heating system should be serviced every year.
exercises.german: Die Heizungsanlage müsste jedes Jahr gewartet werden.
exercises.why: warten has no prefix, so the Partizip II is simply wartet and werden is the last word.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The letter should be answered today.
exercises.german: Der Brief sollte heute beantwortet werden.
exercises.why: The object is in the subject slot, so no accusative object appears in the predicate.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The results should be checked twice.
exercises.german: Die Ergebnisse sollten zweimal überprüft werden.
exercises.why: The frequency adverb sits in the middle of the passive group without breaking the order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The rent should be raised slightly.
exercises.german: Die Miete sollte leicht erhöht werden.
exercises.why: A separable prefix appears as ge- plus participle, and no zu is added before the Partizip II.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: The waste should be separated.
exercises.german: Der Müll sollte getrennt werden.
exercises.why: A short passive clause with only modal, participle and werden in that fixed order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: modal, no würde
exercises.english: A witness should be questioned more carefully.
exercises.german: Ein Zeuge müsste sorgfältiger befragt werden.
exercises.why: The degree adverb compares with the base form but does not displace werden from the end.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The form should be filled in online.
exercises.german: Das Formular würde online ausgefüllt werden.
exercises.why: würde is the sole Konjunktiv II marker, so werden still ends the predicate as an infinitive.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The car would be repaired next week.
exercises.german: Das Auto würde nächste Woche repariert werden.
exercises.why: A modal-verb would not need würde; here würde plus the two infinitives keeps werden last.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The parcel would be delivered on Monday.
exercises.german: Das Paket würde am Montag zugestellt werden.
exercises.why: zustellen forms a separable prefix verb, and the passive uses zugestellt plus werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The decision would be taken without us.
exercises.german: Die Entscheidung würde ohne uns getroffen werden.
exercises.why: The adverbial ohne uns does not create a second accusative object inside the passive.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The website would be revised in autumn.
exercises.german: Die Webseite würde im Herbst überarbeitet werden.
exercises.why: würde plus überarbeitet plus werden: three slots, with the auxiliary-like werden at the very end.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The interview would be conducted in English.
exercises.german: Das Interview würde auf Englisch geführt werden.
exercises.why: The language phrase is an adverbial, so the passive verb group remains untouched.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The books would be moved to the new shelf.
exercises.german: Die Bücher würden in das neue Regal umgeräumt werden.
exercises.why: The dative-like destination phrase can front the verb group without an object in the predicate.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: A solution would probably be found quickly.
exercises.german: Eine Lösung würde vermutlich schnell gefunden werden.
exercises.why: Single infinitive group: the Partizip II and werden form the group, werden is final, würde is finite.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The work would be finished early.
exercises.german: Die Arbeit würde früh beendet werden.
exercises.why: beenden is separable, so beendet fills the participle slot directly before werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The account would be closed at the end of the year.
exercises.german: Das Konto würde am Jahresende geschlossen werden.
exercises.why: A nominal time phrase counts as one member inside the passive group, not as an extra slot.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: Would the room be cleaned?
exercises.german: Würde das Zimmer geputzt werden?
exercises.why: In the interrogative the conjugated würde comes first and the two infinitives follow in order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The results would be presented in public.
exercises.german: Die Ergebnisse würden öffentlich vorgestellt werden.
exercises.why: vorstellen is separable, giving the ge- participle in the middle slot and werden last.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: Nothing would be changed.
exercises.german: Nichts würde geändert werden.
exercises.why: The negated pronoun nothing is the subject, and only the passive worden sense of werden is used.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: Would the deadline be extended?
exercises.german: Würde die Frist verlängert werden?
exercises.why: Question word order plus two infinitives, verlängert before werden, the opposite of würde before verlängert after werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The garden would be redesigned next spring.
exercises.german: Der Garten würde nächsten Früh umgestaltet werden.
exercises.why: A prefixed verb keeps its prefix attached to the participle inside the passive group.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: A small fee would be charged.
exercises.german: Eine kleine Gebühr würde erhoben werden.
exercises.why: The attribute kleine is part of the subject and irrelevant to the passive order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The documents would be sent to your address.
exercises.german: Die Unterlagen würden an Ihre Adresse geschickt werden.
exercises.why: The recipient is expressed adverbially as an an-phrase, so the verb group keeps its slots.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The film would be shown only once.
exercises.german: Der Film würde nur einmal gezeigt werden.
exercises.why: The quantity adverb sits after the modal, and gezeigt still precedes werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The building would be completed in three years.
exercises.german: Der Bau würde in drei Jahren fertiggestellt werden.
exercises.why: fertigstellen is separable, and the temporal phrase occupies one middle slot only.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive: würde
exercises.english: The letter would be signed by the director.
exercises.german: Der Brief würde vom Direktor unterschrieben werden.
exercises.why: Here the von-phrase can stay in the passivische Agens, but the word order is unchanged either way.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The window would have to be repaired.
exercises.german: Das Fenster würde repariert werden müssen.
exercises.why: würde plus a modal forces the double infinitive, and the modal is absolutely the last word.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The window should have been repaired long ago.
exercises.german: Das Fenster hätte längst repariert werden müssen.
exercises.why: Perfekt of the double infinitive: hätte, participle, werden and then the modal at the very end.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The application would have to be submitted in German.
exercises.german: Der Antrag würde auf Deutsch eingereicht werden müssen.
exercises.why: Two stacked infinitives must keep their fixed order, so müssen cannot move in front of eingereicht.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The problem should have been discussed earlier.
exercises.german: Das Problem hätte früher besprochen werden müssen.
exercises.why: The adverbial earlier goes inside the bracket, the modal müssen closes the whole predicate.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The mistake could have been avoided.
exercises.german: Der Fehler hätte vermieden werden können.
exercises.why: In the Perfekt double infinitive the ability modal können ends the sentence, not the passive werden.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: Would the room have to be cleaned?
exercises.german: Würde das Zimmer geputzt werden müssen?
exercises.why: Fronted würde plus two infinitives in questions still keeps the modal in final position.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The results should have been checked twice.
exercises.german: Die Ergebnisse hätten zweimal überprüft werden müssen.
exercises.why: The numeral adverb occupies the middle slot of the double infinitive in the Perfekt.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The old bridge would have to be demolished.
exercises.german: Die alte Brücke würde abgerissen werden müssen.
exercises.why: The separable prefix appears in abgerissen, and the modal müssen follows the passive werden.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The letter should have been answered yesterday.
exercises.german: Der Brief hätte gestern beantwortet werden müssen.
exercises.why: A negated blame reading makes müssen natural here, and its final position proves the double infinitive.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The data should have been deleted earlier.
exercises.german: Die Daten hätten früher gelöscht werden müssen.
exercises.why: Plural data takes hätten, and löschen contributes no prefix to the participle.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: Would the documents have to be copied?
exercises.german: Würden die Unterlagen kopiert werden müssen?
exercises.why: The plural form Würden is required by the plural subject, and the modal still ends the clause.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The proposal could have been discussed at the meeting.
exercises.german: Der Vorschlag hätte auf der Sitzung besprochen werden können.
exercises.why: The modal können in last position expresses that it was possible, not that it happened.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The heating system would have had to be serviced.
exercises.german: Die Heizungsanlage hätte gewartet werden müssen.
exercises.why: A hat plus modal form plus double infinitive: warten has no prefix, so no ge- appears.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The text should have been translated.
exercises.german: Der Text hätte übersetzt werden sollen.
exercises.why: sollen in the double infinitive reports an unfulfilled duty, so it stands at the end.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The rent should not have been raised.
exercises.german: Die Miete hätte nicht erhöht werden dürfen.
exercises.why: The negation precedes the passive group, and the prohibition modal dürfen is the last word.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The form should have been signed.
exercises.german: Das Formular hätte unterschrieben werden müssen.
exercises.why: A modal obligation forces the double infinitive even though only hätte is conjugated.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The meeting might have been cancelled.
exercises.german: Die Sitzung hätte abgesagt werden können.
exercises.why: absagen gives a separable prefix, so abgesagt fills the slot right before the passive werden.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The waste should have been separated.
exercises.german: Der Müll hätte getrennt werden müssen.
exercises.why: trennen is non-separable, which is why there is no ge- before the Partizip II.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: Would the old building have to be demolished?
exercises.german: Würde das alte Gebäude abgerissen werden müssen?
exercises.why: A conditional question in the würde form still requires the modal in final position.

exercises.skill: Double infinitive: modal last
exercises.english: The car should have been serviced before the trip.
exercises.german: Das Auto hätte vor der Reise gründlich gereinigt werden müssen.
exercises.why: Double infinitive: the participle first, then werden, then the modal müssen absolutely last.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The flat should be empty.
exercises.german: Die Wohnung müsste leer sein.
exercises.why: Zustandspassiv uses sein, not werden: the state is described, not the action.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The window is supposed to be broken.
exercises.german: Das Fenster müsste kaputt sein.
exercises.why: A resultant state plus müsste gives Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv with sein in the final slot.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The street should be closed to traffic.
exercises.german: Die Straße müsste gesperrt sein.
exercises.why: gesperrt sein describes the resulting condition of the street, so no werden appears.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The door is supposed to be open.
exercises.german: Die Tür müsste offen sein.
exercises.why: offen sein is a pure state, which is exactly what the Zustandspassiv expresses.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The documents should have been stamped.
exercises.german: Die Unterlagen müssten gestempelt sein.
exercises.why: Plural subject with müssten, and gestempelt sein reports the state of the documents.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The old bridge is supposed to be demolished.
exercises.german: Die alte Brücke müsste abgerissen sein.
exercises.why: The expected end state of the demolition is expressed with sein, not with werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: Work should be done on this project.
exercises.german: An diesem Projekt müsste gearbeitet werden.
exercises.why: Unpersönliches Passiv: an-project takes the preposition, and gearbeitet werden has no agent.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: They should not keep building so many new houses.
exercises.german: Es sollte nicht so viel gebaut werden.
exercises.why: An impersonal es plus the modal passive reports general activity with the pronoun sie left out.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: Would it be possible to talk to the manager?
exercises.german: Mit dem Manager müsste gesprochen werden.
exercises.why: Unpersönliches Passiv in Konjunktiv II: modal finite, werden final, no agent.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: It should not be talked about so much.
exercises.german: Darüber sollte nicht so viel gesprochen werden.
exercises.why: sprechen takes the preposition about it, which signals the unpersönliches Passiv.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The accident was probably caused by carelessness.
exercises.german: Der Unfall müsste durch Unachtsamkeit verursacht worden sein.
exercises.why: The Perfekt of the Konjunktiv II passive needs worden, not geworden, before the modal sein.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The situation should not have been so tense.
exercises.german: Die Lage hätte nicht so angespannt sein müssen.
exercises.why: Here the final modal is a full verb of obligation, so this is a double infinitive with sein.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: Would it be better to wait?
exercises.german: Auf die Antwort müsste länger gewartet werden.
exercises.why: Unpersönliches Passiv with a non-personal subject and no agent.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The window should have been open all day.
exercises.german: Das Fenster müsste den ganzen Tag offen gewesen sein.
exercises.why: Zustandspassiv in the Konjunktiv II Perfekt: sein as the state auxiliary, ending in gewesen sein.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The kitchen is supposed to be renovated next month.
exercises.german: Die Küche müsste nächsten Monat renoviert sein.
exercises.why: The time phrase describes when the state will hold, so the state itself is predicated with sein.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: The children should be spoken to more kindly.
exercises.german: Mit den Kindern müsste freundlicher gesprochen werden.
exercises.why: Unpersönliches Passiv with a dative object: mit den Kindern precedes the passive verb group.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: It should be clarified that this cannot stay like this.
exercises.german: Es müsste klargestellt werden, dass das nicht so bleiben kann.
exercises.why: Konjunktiv II Vorgangspassiv with a dass-clause complement after werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: Would it be said if we stayed at home?
exercises.german: Wäre es gesagt worden, wenn wir zu Hause geblieben wären?
exercises.why: Vorgangspassiv in the Konjunktiv II Perfekt: worden … gewesen with no modal, and geblieben as the finite verb of the second clause.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: In the past a lot more was written by hand.
exercises.german: Früher müsste viel mehr von Hand geschrieben worden sein.
exercises.why: Modal first, participle, then worden plus sein, and no werden anywhere in the sentence.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II Zustandspassiv and unpersönliches Passiv
exercises.english: Such questions are usually asked more directly.
exercises.german: Solche Fragen müssten direkter gestellt werden.
exercises.why: stellen with a plural subject takes müssten, and the passive verb group closes the sentence.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: He says the window must be repaired.
exercises.german: Er sagt, das Fenster müsse repariert werden.
exercises.why: In indirect speech the modal drops to müsse and stands before the two passive infinitives.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: She said that the form should be filled in.
exercises.german: Sie sagte, das Formular müsse ausgefüllt werden.
exercises.why: Reported past speech uses the Konjunktiv II müsse, and the clause keeps verb-final order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: The teacher said that the homework should be done carefully.
exercises.german: Die Lehrerin sagte, die Hausaufgaben müssten sorgfältig gemacht werden.
exercises.why: The plural subject triggers müssten, and the modal stays at the head of the passive group.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: The boss insists that the report be finished today.
exercises.german: Der Chef besteht darauf, dass der Bericht heute fertiggestellt werden müsse.
exercises.why: A final-style dass-clause puts the modal müsse at the very end, after the passive werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: It could be that the meeting has been cancelled.
exercises.german: Es könnte sein, dass die Sitzung abgesagt worden ist.
exercises.why: The dass-clause uses the Perfekt of the passive; worden shows the passive of abgesagt.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: She thinks the picture should be bought.
exercises.german: Sie meint, das Bild müsse gekauft werden.
exercises.why: Meinen in the Konjunktiv II, here a modal, frames the passive as unverified reported opinion.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: Whether it should be printed in colour is not clear.
exercises.german: Ob es in Farbe gedruckt werden sollte, ist nicht klar.
exercises.why: An indirect question in the ob-clause puts the modal sollte after the passive werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: The lawyer asked whether the contract should be changed.
exercises.german: Die Anwältin fragte, ob der Vertrag geändert werden müsste.
exercises.why: An embedded question needs the Konjunktiv II müsste in final position, not indicative müsste must.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: We assumed that the tickets would be refunded.
exercises.german: Wir gingen davon aus, dass die Tickets erstattet würden.
exercises.why: With würde alone the passive infinitive stays last: erstattet wurden would be wrong word order.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: It seemed as if the window had to be replaced.
exercises.german: Es schien, als müsste das Fenster ersetzt werden.
exercises.why: The comparison müsste before the passive infinitive shows the modal form of the Konjunktiv II.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: I heard that the road should be widened.
exercises.german: Ich hörte, dass die Straße verbreitert werden solle.
exercises.why: In reported speech the form of sollen is solle, standing before verbreitert werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: It matters whether the appointments are kept.
exercises.german: Es ist entscheidend, ob die Termine eingehalten werden müssten.
exercises.why: A modal-substitute in Konjunktiv II in the ob-clause needs müssten in the final slot.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: The manager demanded that the work be stopped.
exercises.german: Die Chefin verlangte, dass die Arbeit eingestellt werden müsse.
exercises.why: A demand-style dass-clause ends with the modal, and einstellen keeps its separable prefix.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: The doctor recommended that the examination be repeated.
exercises.german: Der Arzt empfahl, dass die Untersuchung noch einmal gemacht werden sollte.
exercises.why: A recommendation normally takes indicative, but a careful doctor recommends with sollte.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: Nobody thought that the deadline could be extended.
exercises.german: Niemand dachte, dass die Frist verlängert werden könnte.
exercises.why: könnte replaces könnte-indicative in reported speech and stays before the passive werden.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: Although it was only a small matter, the rule should be applied.
exercises.german: Obwohl es nur eine Kleinigkeit war, sollte die Regel angewendet werden.
exercises.why: The obwohl-clause is indicative in the past, while the main clause carries the Konjunktiv II passive.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: Because the documents were missing, the application must be submitted again.
exercises.german: Weil die Unterlagen fehlten, müsste der Antrag erneut eingereicht werden.
exercises.why: The cause clause stays indicative, while müsste in the main clause marks a deduced Konjunktiv II obligation.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: Since the tickets were cheap, they should be bought early.
exercises.german: Da die Tickets billig waren, sollten sie früh gekauft werden.
exercises.why: da as a real reason stays indicative, and the modal passive in the main clause is Konjunktiv II.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: Although the meeting was short, the decision should have been made.
exercises.german: Obwohl die Sitzung kurz war, hätte die Entscheidung getroffen werden müssen.
exercises.why: A concessive clause plus a Perfekt double infinitive: the modal müssen is the last word.

exercises.skill: Konjunktiv II passive in subordinate clauses and indirect speech
exercises.english: As the tenant complained, the flat should have been renovated earlier.
exercises.german: Da der Mieter sich beschwert hatte, hätte die Wohnung früher renoviert werden müssen.
exercises.why: The reason clause uses the indicative Perfekt while the main clause keeps the modal passive.
